messages:
Elena Morales: Heads up 1 interviewers reported getting duplicate 24h reminder emails for the same onboarding session today. They saw the invite + two reminders.
Priya Nair: I got 2 reports as well. One interviewer said it felt spammy and asked to be unsubscribed.
Marcus Lee: any recent infra work on reminder webhooks?
Rina Shah: we ran a backfill last night to retry failed webhook deliveries to calendar providers. Might have re-triggered reminder jobs for sessions in the retry window.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-945 ats-reminder-duplicates-backfill. Assigned to eng-infra.
Elena Morales: impact: some interviewers saw duplicate reminders, and a couple of exec-level interviewers replied asking to remove extras. We should stop further duplicates ASAP.
Marcus Lee: short-term: can we pause the reminder dispatch job and throttle retries?
Rina Shah: yes. I can add a dedupe window for reminder delivery keyed on (user_email, session_id, reminder_type) last 48h. Can toggle the job to dry-run in 10 min.
Priya Nair: good. Also need to patch the backfill so it doesn't re-emit reminders when replaying webhook events. Backfill should be idempotent.
Rina Shah: Agreed. Plan: 1) pause reminder cron (ETA: 10m) 2) enable dedupe-safeguard on reminder API (ETA: 2h) 3) patch backfill to mark webhook replays as "no-reminder" (ETA: next deploy).
RecruitingBot: Alert: 12 affected interviewers detected by auto-scan. Sending apology + consolidated invite to affected users.
Elena Morales: pls also send an internal note to the recruiting rotation so they don't contact interviewers twice.
Marcus Lee: I'll message the rotation and ask them to ignore duplicate replies.
Rina Shah: running pause now. Also adding a short-term compensating control: if a session has >1 upcoming reminder event queued, collapse to single.
ops-bot: INC-2026-945 status -> in_progress.
Priya Nair: after patch, can we run a quick audit to ensure no reminders were dropped for legitimate cases? We don't want to under-notify.
Rina Shah: will run a dry-run audit comparing expected vs sent counts and post results here.
Elena Morales: thanks. Please post the remediation note and the PR link so we can update the recruiter playbook and incident log.
Rina Shah: PR opened: github.com/redwood/ats/pull/1248 reminder-dedupe-and-backfill-guard. Posting results in 2h.
RecruitingBot: Update: 12 apology emails sent; reminders paused.
Elena Morales: great work, team.
